1.consolidated_definition: Resultaba difícil obtener las denominaciones correspondientes a narigudo ...; algunos sujetos eludían el vocablo diciendo que se refería a personas con nariz perfilaíta.
1.en_consolidated_definition: It was difficult to obtain the corresponding designations for narigudo; some individuals avoided using the term, claiming it referred to people with a pointed nose.
